title: A Sleigh of One's Own
overview: One woman's journey of self-discovery and coming to terms with her husband's sexuality. That woman? Mrs. Claus.

title: Heart Eyes 2
overview: The sequel to the 2025 film. Plot TBA.

title: Escape From Letterkenny
overview: A Metalhead makes a deal with God...  This film follows the intertwining meanderings of some typical Letterkenny residents over a few highly eventful days. Some are good, some are bad, some are morally vague. All are trapped in the same town. This film is about getting out. It's about breaking the shackles that hold you back by any means necessary, even if that means embracing utter chaos. It's about standing up to your outer demon. It's about friendship. It's about blossoming love. It's about dodgy-looking drugs. It will wreck your head. Or at the very least, it will make you question what kind of God you have.

title: Carl Sagan: We Are Made of Star Stuff
original_title: Carl Sagan: We Are Made of Star Stuff
overview: An intimate and cinematic portrait of astronomer and planetary scientist Carl Sagan.

title: born blue
overview: PLEASE NOTE: June 2027 is not a confirmed date. It is our target completion date and may change.  Born In Blue is produced using Unreal Engine. Unreal Engine is a trademark or registered trademark of Epic Games, Inc. All rights reserved.  Set in Mount Gambier, South Australia, the film follows Lumy, a young girl who witnesses her father’s sacrifice at the edge of the mysterious Blue Lake. Growing up with unhealed trauma and an unexplainable power tied to the water itself, Lumy retreats into science while being quietly hunted by forces she doesn’t fully understand.  Years later, she forms a deep connection with a broken but kindred soul, Ashton. Together, they become scientists and uncover a dangerous truth buried beneath the lake one that links Lumy’s existence to a phenomenon capable of reshaping reality. As the past resurfaces and the hunters return, Lumy must confront what her father died to protect. Born In Blue is a story of grief, survival, inheritance, and the cost of love.

title: A Place in Hell
overview: A top criminal defense attorney, known for representing unlikeable clients in high-profile cases, is a relentless workhorse at her firm and fully expects to be named partner. When another attorney joins the firm, her job is put to the test and makes her question just how far she’ll go to protect it.

title: The Surgeon
overview: A former surgeon is kidnapped and given an impossible choice.

title: What Happened to Doris?
overview: In 1974 LA suburbs, a single mom faces violent attacks by an invisible entity. When no one believes her, she seeks help from paranormal investigators, sparking a notorious documented supernatural case.

title: Remain
overview: When reclusive architect Tate Gordon moves to small coastal town to complete his latest project, he encounters an alluring young woman who pulls him out of his shell, and into the center of a deadly mystery that hangs over the town.

title: The Rescue
overview: A former rodeo cowboy takes matters into his own hands when his daughter is kidnapped for ransom. With her devoted dog by his side, he sets out to bring her home and will stop at nothing to find her.

title: Clarissa
overview: Across a single day in Lagos, Nigeria, Clarissa prepares to host a high society party at her home, as her complicated past begins to consume her, in the form of now-distant friends and loves from her youth. Simultaneously, Septimus, a young soldier, is haunted by his own memories of the horrors he has witnessed and endured. As the perspectives traverse past and present, across the bourgeois class and those too easily forgotten by society, a delicate portrait of contemporary Nigeria emerges.

title: Unholy Night
overview: The film centers on Gino, whose traditional Italian family Christmas Eve celebration descends into chaos when his deceased grandmother returns from the dead and embarks on a killing spree.  As more dead relatives begin appearing throughout the neighborhood, Gino must find a way to eliminate the holiday revenants and make it through the family gathering alive.

title: The Defectors
overview: In a near-future surveillance state, a detective secretly aligned with a rebellion investigates the assassination of their leader under the watchful eye of his manipulative new partner.

title: One Sweet Hour
overview: An ageing Elvis impersonator finally faces up to his demons as he travels through the Irish midlands with his long-lost brother, who has recently quit his life in a monastery.

title: Jimmy
overview: A look into the life of American actor James Stewart, whose inspiring tale of valor, purpose and faith will win over everyone.

title: Being Heumann
overview: Scrappy, defiant, and done being treated like a burden, Judy Heumann turns her outrage into a revolution. In 1977, she and more than 100 disability rights protestors send a very loud message: The system is broken—not us.

title: Friends Like Us
overview: A dark comedic thriller where two sitcom actors have to reenact a new version of their show’s series finale after a crazed fan keeps them hostage.

title: Riverrun
overview: Lucy is a musician who is slowly losing control over her body and voice. Her psychiatrist Dr. Cruz sends her to a clinic in Spain where she meets Tony. What begins as a treatment slowly becomes a journey towards an unexpected understanding of herself.

title: Convince Me
overview: When a heartbroken man is forced to convince the Devil to grant his wish, he must face the truth about himself or risk paying an eternal price.

title: The Apex Predators Club
overview: On a remote island where the rich hunt monsters, the game flips when the hunters become prey. With savage beasts closing in and no escape, survival is the only rule. Welcome to The Apex Predators Club.

title: These Violent Delights
overview: Juliet awakens from a fever dream. How did we get here? The lines between hallucination and memory blur as cinema and dance collide in a kaleidoscopic journey of queer belonging, defiance, and self-discovery. A vivid retelling of Shakespeare’s Romeo and Juliet brought to life by Scottish Ballet.

title: Freakshow
overview: While a group of mimes are getting ready for a performance, one of them reaches a breaking point.

title: Marilyn's Dark Paradise
overview: An adventurous time traveler befriends Marilyn Monroe and struggles with adhering to the rigid rules of time travel.

title: Symbiotica
overview: When Margerie Dollop gives birth to her unconventional baby, she is met with an impossible decision once something starts knocking from its insides.

title: Norm: The Tale of Norm Macdonald
original_title: Norm: The Tale of Norm Macdonald
overview: Go down a wormhole in this documentary on master of deadpan humor Norm Macdonald, whose life and career were uncompromising yet full of contradictions.

title: The Last Yztari
overview: Mary Dague lost both arms defusing bombs in Iraq. She tried for years to write her story and couldn't. Eighteen years later, she's building a world where that trauma belongs to someone else—narrated by DANI, the artificial consciousness she created to watch over her fictional selves. The film reveals her rebuilding identity through imagination, and asks what happens when the only way to tell the truth is through fiction.

title: 3 Days Rising
overview: Living in self-imposed exile, Eric Usher battles his own conscience and reality itself as he must choose between his siblings, Rick and Cher, and his own salvation. Life and death consequences hinge on Eric's resolve and sanity as he navigates a world filled with strange interlopers climaxing with an explosively violent twist ending reveal Poe himself would be proud of.

title: Christmas & Chaos
overview: Two musicians with clashing styles join forces to create music that will wow a powerful impresario and his associate. Their collaboration is key to keeping their show alive and thriving in a competitive industry.

title: Casualty
overview: At the outset of Operation Desert Storm, a mortally wounded Kurdish surgeon reflects on his history—both personal and political—as he observes the bombing of Baghdad from a well outside the city.

title: Loved One
overview: Sandy's compulsive need to save her eldest daughter Jess collides with her responsibility to celebrate her younger daughter's college graduation, forcing her to confront the line between love and obsession.

title: Mayookha
overview: Mayookha, a young professional living alone in a urban city. When a string of brutal murders rocks the city, targeting single women . She starts noticing strange occurrences around her apartment. She's convinced she's the next target.

title: Treasure Trekkers
overview: A 12-year-old monkey called Mip struggles to find his place in a world dominated by cats and rodents. A magic map sets him on a perilous quest in search of his roots in the distant land of Empathra and a journey that will teach him that kindness is a superpower.

title: Subscriber
overview: An obnoxious real estate YouTuber takes his crew to a dilapidated farmhouse in Ohio, one of his recent purchases. Once they enter the remote house, they learn there is an entity not of this earth that refuses to let them leave…

title: Pocket Mirror
overview: A lonely retail clerk who spends most of her time chatting with AI struggles to identify the source of her unshakeable unease.

title: Skin and Pavement
overview: An insecure aspiring athlete pushes himself to the limit and faces the consequences.

title: Livestream from Hell
overview: When Kevin Hart teams up with fellow comedian, Druski, and streamer, Kai Cenat for a record-breaking livestream at his tech-savvy mansion, things go hilariously off the rails, until the pranks turn to panic, and a real murder mystery unfolds on camera, trapping the trio and their celebrity guests in a high-stakes, horror-comedy whodunnit watched by millions.

title: Globe
overview: Globe is a cinematic folktale about identity, belonging, and resistance, set amid the tribal land struggles of Kerala. Seen through Kariyan, a young tribal boy, the film reflects the deep bond indigenous communities share with their land and the alienation they face in urban society. Rooted in Attappadi, the story subtly reveals ancestral dispossession and cultural erasure, urging reflection on justice, dignity, and the right to remain in one’s birthplace.

title: Uprooted
overview: Just as a couple prepares to welcome their long-awaited child, a devoted couple meets a troubled teen whose wounded heart resists faith. Their paths intertwine in a story of love, healing, and unexpected grace.

title: The Route to Cappyness
overview: A filmmaker embarks on a global adventure to uncover the viral fascination of the capybara, including exploring how they have become cultural symbols of serenity in Japan.

title: The Swallow
overview: Ziggy and her four friends journey out on a camping trip to a picturesque remote forest. But trespassing into an off-limits area, they awaken an uncanny terror in the woods... and a ravenous hunger from within the Earth. Soon, the ground itself is trying to swallow anything and anyone it comes into contact with and Ziggy and her friends have nowhere to run as every trembling step they take could be their last.

title: This Is Our City
overview: The ambitious son of a ruthless mob boss hires a film crew, who end up being undercover FBI agents, to document his life as a dysfunctional and delusional gangster.

title: REO: The Dangerous Peak
overview: A documentary following a young mountaineer, Yashwanth Naik, on an expedition to Mount Reo Purgyil in Himachal Pradesh.

title: Dasher
overview: A down-and-out food delivery driver, Josh, and a fiery restaurant worker, Kayla, team up for a comedic and chaotic night of deliveries. Demanding customers, stolen sushi, and the festive mayhem on Christmas Eve push some life back into their lives and get them to dream just a bit more. Set in urban Honolulu, DASHER is a local take on what’s likely a nationwide story for young people living the gig economy – where working long hours just to get by discourages any life beyond the next gig.

title: By Yourself
overview: Following a breakup, Syl goes solo camping in the deep woods to unplug and connect with herself. Her solitude turns sinister when she wakes to find a neighboring tent that wasn’t there the night before.

title: AGENT: STRONG
overview: A mild-mannered family man and staunch supporter of Robert Kennedy Jr, ALEX STRONG is tasked by a mysterious agency with stopping evildoers from putting fluoride in his town's water supply; pushing him into a surreal web of conspiracies where the fate of America, and the world is at stake.

title: Angor
overview: An enigmatic renegade young man, a melancholic stalked young woman, a mysterious murdered young girl and an eminent ruthless old cardinal: They live in a faithful relationship but their reciprocal dependence will soon become a pain to be freed from. Fighting desperately. Who will survive?

title: Pathetic Fallacy
overview: A grieving young widower seeks healing in a spiritual mountain town but encounters a bizarre murderer and demonic forest spirits who offer him the power to cheat death at a terrifying cost.

title: Guard
overview: A young lifeguard finds herself isolated from her peers as she struggles with the weight of mortality.

title: Strange Spirits
overview: In a haunted roadside bar run by the mysterious Ghoulian Madman, a series of twisted horror stories unfold, from cursed video games and alien body snatchers to killer clowns and supernatural nightmares, proving every spirit has a story.

title: Fly Train
overview: Like a bee tracing the windows of an endless train, thoughts on an ordinary journey drift between scenery and fragmented memories. Through experimental shadow play, everyday silhouettes transform into the surreal, slipping into a hypnotic stream of consciousness. As the wheels turn, the search for memory's meaning fades, leaving us to immerse ourselves in the ephemeral, flickering flow of frames.

title: Inside Kent's Drag Bubble
overview: A colorful portrait of Kent Ohio's local drag scene, following performers as they balance school, identity, and art.

title: Not Your Average Girl
overview: Not Your Average Girl is a journey through survival and becoming—a visual memoir that dares to tell the story behind the spotlight. From growing up in the South to standing in her power at the 2025 BET Black & Iconic Awards, Hope offers viewers a raw and intimate look at the trials, triumphs, and tenderness that shaped her. This is a love letter to every Black trans girl who’s ever been told she wouldn’t make it—and a reckoning with the systems that tried to silence her.

title: Cereal Killers
overview: A ex-detective, now turned high school principal attempts to solve a case involving 3 strange students.

title: Jackrabbit
overview: When a coal miner in 1930s Utah hides the loss of his job from his family, the quiet deception sets off a slow-burning collapse.

title: Sparks
overview: Two late-20s Londoners walk home from their first date and see the exact life they will have if they pursue the sparks between them.

title: Sport Star
overview: An aging black high school football star, living a quotidian life and married to his high school sweetheart in a small town, reminisces over a long-lost lover - a man he once shared the football field with.

title: CHASING RAHUL
overview: In modern-day Bangalore, Sama sets on to chase the old-school romance she grew up believing in, all while discovering the little beauties of Bangalore city.

title: Premature
overview: After an impulsive one-night stand leads to an unexpected pregnancy, two flatmates must confront who they are, and who they want to be, before the baby arrives.

title: The Mini Chainsaw Massacre
overview: While driving a forgotten back road, a young couple is forced into a brutal fight for survival against a chainsaw-wielding madman.

title: Kylgor in the Grisly Abyss
overview: Kylgor and his band of fellow survivors set out for revenge and to behead the Evil King Kath but unexpectedly plummet into the Grisly Abyss.

title: Wellness Retreat
overview: A successful business woman seeks out a wellness retreat to improve her sleep. When she finds the location is actually a seedy motel, her exhaustion takes the lead and she chooses to stay the night, despite her better judgment.

title: TEENAGERS
overview: Six old friends gather at Megan’s house for a quiet reunion while her parents are away. What begins as a casual night of music, drinks, and nostalgia quickly becomes tense as old memories resurface and the group dynamic begins to fracture. As the night goes on, an unsettling feeling takes hold, turning the familiar setting into something increasingly dangerous.

title: RE/ROUTE
overview: Blending documentary footage with striking visual collage, RE/ROUTE imagines two competing visions of urban life. One is ruled by cars, productivity, unchecked capitalism and individualism; the other prioritizes connection, leisure and inclusion. As familiar cityscapes morph into surreal tableaux, the film invites us to reconsider how urban design shapes our communities, our relationships, our futures.

title: Butter Chicken to Go
overview: Three South Asian delivery drivers brave Toronto’s winter dinner rush, zipping through slushy, frigid streets. Through intimate portraits of the drivers, Butter Chicken to Go exposes a deep contradiction: a country that eagerly consumes South Asian cuisine while increasingly excluding the people whose labour sustains it. What does it mean to belong when your presence is both essential and contested?

title: Restaurant Kids
overview: Raised between dining rooms and take–out counters, the children of Halifax’s Chinese restaurateurs share stories of family, hard work and identity. Through intimate conversations and personal memories, Restaurant Kids celebrates a tight-knit community whose businesses became gathering places, livelihoods and second homes for a generation growing up between cultures.

title: pahkwêsikan sâkihitowin: Bannock is Love
overview: Gathering family, friends and community members around a beloved traditional food, pahkwêsikan sâkihitowin: Bannock is Love reflects on the role of bannock in sustaining Indigenous identity, memory and connection. Through stories shared across generationsand moving through different contexts, the film reveals how cultural traditions nourish not only the body, but also the spirit, resilience and future of a people.

title: La Prospettiva [1653]
overview: Perspective and permanence inform Ben Russell’s playful La Prospettiva (1653), filmed in the Colonnade at the Palazzo Spada in Rome, capturing the central composition of the Baroque illusionism masterpiece but also modest moments of the labour  dedicated to its upkeep.

title: Tehran, Under the Skin
overview: In an age of body anxiety, filmmaker Afsaneh Salari embeds herself in the offices of Iranian plastic surgeons to interview their clients with humour and empathy.

title: 70 Up
overview: Across seven decades, British viewers watched 14 children grow into adults in films broadcast every seven years. In the series' final installment – with all surviving participants now in their seventies – what do their lives tell us about Britain?

title: Run Hide Fight: Infidels
overview: When radical Islamist terrorists hijack a liberal college's pro-Palestine encampment, a ragtag band of red-blooded students, a security guard, and a Delta Force vet must arm up to save their clueless peers.

title: Darlene Love: I Know Where I've Been
original_title: Darlene Love: I Know Where I've Been
overview: A documentary on Darlene Love, the singer and Rock & Roll Hall of Fame inductee known for “He’s a Rebel” and collaborations with Cher, Bruce Springsteen, Dionne Warwick, Sam Cooke and other greats.

title: Sunlight Water
overview: When a lonely, recently single woman rescues a houseplant in need of serious TLC – and then falls in love with it – she must discover what the plant really wants, or risk losing herself forever.

title: Future Tense
overview: Cape Town, South Africa. In a near future on the brink of climate collapse, Lwando and his girlfriend Tara are among the privileged few who win the opportunity to travel back to 1647 and a pre-colonial past to experience nature in its wildest form. Lwando is an underground activist who dreams of changing the course of history. Tara wants to save her relationship with him. Together, the couple must choose whether to risk life as they know it for a potentially better world.

title: Aineolach
overview: When a grieving gay minister relocates to a remote Hebridean village to preach, he's met with a few frosty smiles and silent judgement. But as the island's first Pride begins to bloom in secret, he must choose between blending in or standing up — risking his peace, his purpose, and maybe even his heart.

title: His Best Man
overview: Two lovers reunite after years apart, only for one to be engaged and ready to move on and engaged to a new man. He asks his old lover to be his best man and bless his new union. His best Man is a gay South-Asian romantic musical comedy, but less Bollywood and more Indian-Western fusion music.

title: The Taller They Come
overview: A wannabe Australian film director travels to Ghana to produce his dream film, a kung-fu remake of The Harder They Come with Ghanian action sensation, Samuel “Ninja” Nkansah.

title: Steamboat Killie
overview: A small town is shaken when a series of brutal murders begins, all linked by one disturbing detail: the killer is dressed in a Mickey Mouse costume. As the body count rises, a group of locals races to uncover who's behind the mask before the killer strikes again.

title: The Life and Deaths of Wilson Shedd
original_title: The Life and Deaths of Wilson Shedd
overview: A teacher in an abusive marriage takes a job at a maximum security prison, where she falls for a charismatic inmate. The disastrous consequences call into question not only the nature of punishment and retribution, but the very limits of our humanity.

title: Above the Trees
overview: When something inhuman follows her home through the woods, Vera Landen calls the only voice she can reach - a late night radio host who decides her terror makes better entertainment than emergency.

title: Purgatory
overview: In the early 1980s, 13-year-old Beatrice Gravel's comfortable world—family, school, and church—fractures when her mother moves out to 'self actualize', leaving Beatrice and her younger sister Chloe with their devastated father. As Beatrice doubles down on a plan to 'fix' her family, she barrels through bullies, friendship blowups, a make-out party, and a kleptomaniac babysitter—forcing her to decide who she wants to be when she can’t get what she wants.

title: CONTACT
overview: CONTACT is a short documentary film directed by Jonathan Walley that chronicles the transformation of an entire skatepark into a playable musical instrument—where the skate, BMX, art, and music scenes collide.  HCS has been many things: a skatepark, gallery, library, museum, and stage; but, for one weekend, Derek Nelson fabricator,  activist, BMX pro, and artist, transformed his skatepark into an immersive sonic installation—part instrument, part playground—for the community of Binghamton, NY to become co‑creators in a conflagration of sound. SMALL TOWN, BIG SOUND.  CONTACT reminds us of the joy in creativity, community, and the DIY spirit. Contact is about pushing boundaries, experimenting with art, and reclaiming space in an increasingly cruel, unkind, and oppressive world. It’s a poetic exploration of the creative process told by a filmmaker who calls HCS home.

title: Exit Only
overview: Cade hears about strange noises coming from one of his theater exits.

title: How Much Are You Willing to Sacrifice
original_title: How Much Are You Willing to Sacrifice
overview: Damien Malvolio is a fresh face in the acting scene, he gets handed an audition of a lifetime with a big name director from his hometown (Ransom Wells). His best friend Rigby Hollander is also an actor that gets handed the same role. Rigby Gets the part while Damien falls into madness seeing his best friend steal his role from him. Damien tries everything to take back the role that was destined for him, even if it means ruining their friendship.

title: Closing Night
overview: A celebrated actress's life begins to unravel on the eve of her greatest performance. When her sister April arrives in New York after a 30-year estrangement, the stage is set for a tense family confrontation.

title: Drifter
overview: In a forgotten desert town, a solitary racetrack janitor with a gift for drifting is haunted by his tragic past. Given a single chance to compete at a pro drifting event, he discovers his raw talent is useless without the one thing he's always avoided: connection with others. Under a hardened mentor, he must learn to trust his found family and transform his untamed, lonely art into a dangerous dance of partnership, or be consumed and controlled by the past he's desperate to escape.

title: Dying for Love
overview: In 1991 Miami, a young woman secretly dying of HIV finally finds the man of her dreams, and risks the only thing scarier than her diagnosis—telling the fatal truth to the man she loves.

title: Whatcha Want
overview: When a young trophy wife and recent immigrant from Hong Kong uncovers her wealthy husband's betrayal, she reignites her passion for dance, forcing her to choose between the life she was given and the liberation she longs for.

title: Lemonade
overview: Danny, a kind-hearted teen about to age out of the care system is facing adulthood without family or support. After a turbulent childhood and separation from his younger brother, Danny is determined to build a future - but one reckless mistake puts him at risk of prison. As his 18th birthday approaches, Josh - his former social worker and the only adult who ever believed in him - returns, offering guidance when Danny needs it most. With new love, big dreams, and overwhelming challenges, Danny must choose whether to repeat the cycle of his past or fight for the life he deserves.

title: The Ultra Runner
overview: Driven by a violent past and hardened by years of crime and incarceration, Romanian ultramarathoner Tibi Ușeriu battles endless terrain and his own demons  in search of a better life for his family, his country, and himself.

title: Wired Together
overview: Ivy and Alex are two normal people who happened to fall in love at first sight in the library. Neither of them knew the toll and effect the other's presence, or lack thereof, would have on their life. As they enter the first major challenge of their relationship, long distance, they must accept that sometimes things do change.

title: This Time, I Mean It
overview: This Time, I Mean It, is a Comedy Drama that follows the story of Sam, who must fight against time to stop his girlfriend from leaving his life forever.

title: Faith
overview: Gina, a hard-working and devoted single mother, meets a quietly enigmatic stranger, Michael. The presence of someone who appears to care for her brings a new and exciting dynamic to her life, despite the fact she knows nothing about him or what his intentions towards her really are. Is he a friend, a potential lover or something more sinister?

title: Zoners
overview: A desperate young woman is forced to drive a mercenary and a stolen alien device through a land infested with monsters.

title: Colour Green
overview: A couple ventures into a random motel, sharing stories on a trip that eventually falls apart.

title: Trash Mountain
overview: A twenty something gay man travels from Chicago to his home in rural Missouri following the death of his father — an obsessive hoarder who has left a house full of items, some valuable and some not so, to pick through.

title: The Face of Horror
overview: In medieval England, the beautiful Eleanor pines away for her errant husband, the handsome but adulterous knight Edward. When Edward’s treachery culminates in a tragedy that robs Eleanor first of her beauty and then of her life, she returns as a ghost to eke bloody revenge on Edward and his new bride.

title: Black Forest
overview: Jack and Alice find a video camera while hiking in the woods. As he reviews the footage, Jack’s sanity is pushed to the limits as the people he watches calls out to him looking for his soul.

title: On The Cutting Room Floor
overview: When two filmmakers, Lana and Keith, become entangled in each other's lives, personally and professionally, it becomes apparent that their relationship is less stable than it seemed.

title: Twist & Shoot: Mister Suzuki
overview: Seijun Suzuki became a cinema legend in the 1960s with a handful of pop-art films. So how can you make a portrait of this iconoclastic director without also adopting a 'style to kill' documentary convention, as well as testimonies from a variety of leading figures in contemporary Japanese and international filmmakers.

title: The Apple is Poison
overview: A man finds a mysterious yet threatening note in a bunch of apples.

title: The Housewife
overview: A young New York Times journalist tracking down a potential Nazi officer living secretly in Queens.

title: Censor Addiction
overview: In 2030, a group of former employees band together to take down a corrupt medical giant determined to increase the levels of crime throughout the country.

title: The Train
overview: On the final journey of the legendary Majestic Imperator Train de Luxe, Europe’s elite boards for a farewell voyage. Owner Leo Goldberg stages a glamorous on-board show and private auction as the train travels from Vienna to Prague via Budapest, selling the Majestic to the highest bidder. But the train is more than a luxury relic: it is a controlled, mobile platform with secure compartments, limited exits, and near-total anonymity. That makes it irresistible to intelligence agencies. A Russian agent under deep cover, MI6 operatives posing as newlyweds, Chinese agents secretly wiring the train for surveillance, and a former special forces officer traveling with his daughter all converge on board. Behind champagne and polite conversation, a covert war unfolds. As the train speeds through the night, the stakes rise, trust erodes, and escape routes disappear.

title: Well Being
overview: Short film written by Emir Kuliev, directed by Kevin McNally.

title: Place to Be
overview: No-nonsense Brooke and discombobulated divorcee Nelson travel from Chicago to New York to return a lost racing pigeon home.

title: Faux Amis
overview: Adele and May, two American twenty-somethings with different backgrounds and a less than sturdy friendship, travel together to Paris so that Adele can finally unite with the handsome Jacques, an (unbeknownst to the women) reclusive local there who has been courting Adele from across the Atlantic via Instagram. The city is not kind to their relationship.

title: Brown Sheep
overview: 16-year-old Jamila navigates adolescence and natural hair confidence whilst reminiscing her mother; and attending a predominantly white school.

title: The Hooters Murders: Deadly Shift
overview: Between 2001 and 2010, separated by thousands of miles, the victims shared one connection: they were all associated with Hooters. The Hooters Murders: Deadly Shift is a two-hour documentary that unravels these tragic murders, exposing how young women who were linked to the iconic restaurant chain were preyed upon.

title: Just A Wish Away
overview: When Micky lands a surprise radio interview on the same night as the class of '86 end of year prom, he risks hurting Linda who secretly hoped he would ask her to the dance.

title: Go Home
overview: A 38-year-old single Dutch woman finds herself like a stranger in her hometown after years of working in Afghanistan with the United Nations.

title: WWE Sunday Night's Main Event
overview: The first ever WWE Sunday Night's Main Event takes place on Sunday, September 6, 2026, live from the State Farm Arena in Atlanta, Georgia during Labor Day weekend. The special television event streams live in the U.S. on Peacock starting at 8 p.m. ET.

title: The Cactus
overview: As Trysdale prepared for the year-end international exchange formal with Odessey and Malvous in a quiet afternoon, his thoughts drifted to an exchange student named Hecate when he once again locked eyes with the cactus she gave to him, whose fleeting connection with him had dissolved into quiet regret, or maybe there's still a glimpse of chance?

title: Spiral
overview: While celebrating his engagement, Sean finds out that his future brother-in-law has an unnaturally large penis.

title: Late Night At The Movies
overview: After an Employee goes missing, Kayleigh is called into work on her only day off. She plans on spending the night after hours only to find that something sinister is lurking throughout the Theater - Stalking her.

title: Mel
overview: A man recounts a dream to his doctor where he pursues a woman who feels hauntingly familiar.

title: Delineations
overview: "Delineations" is an experimental short film highlighting Long Island, New York. Made using satellite images from Google Earth, the film explores nostalgia, growth, and confinement.

title: The Idiot(s)
overview: Fyodor Dostoyevsky and his wife Anna travel to Europe for their honeymoon and end up staying in a health resort in Switzerland, only to return to Russia after four years. Fyedya can’t shake his roulette habit and keeps losing their money. His wife accepts this fate since he keeps assuring her that it’s all for inspiration and soon he shall write his to-be masterpiece, 'The Idiot'.

title: The Blue Sea
overview: A fisherman has the impression that he is rotting from the inside, like one of his teeth that is bothering him. Lost in the maze of his painful memories, frustrated by the sense of disorder that surrounds him, he is helpless in the face of the spectacle of the repressed demonstrators he sees every day on television. His depression causes his body to melt in an abstract way and to disperse in trails of droplets, in the manner of Francis Bacon's portraits.

title: A Few Moments of Happiness
overview: A young woman watches the war in Lebanon through her phone, from her bed in Paris. Through digital images, family voices, and silences, the film explores the dissociation of a generation condemned to witness the destruction of the world from afar. An intimate essay on exile, screens, and the exhaustion of being a witness.

title: Magpie
overview: Following the death of her mother, a young and talented pianist must find her way through monumental loss while preparing for an important audition. As grief and ambition begin to clash, Liz attempts to maintain a sense of normalcy while navigating the expectations from both herself and others. However, as she spirals through the stages of denial, anger, and devastation; she must come face-to-face with her loss and confront her grief through music.

title: Eternity One
overview: ETERNITY ONE follows Mary Ella, a young girl growing up on Tangier Island in the Chesapeake Bay, where rising seas have already claimed two-thirds of the land and threaten to erase what remains. Once a thriving fishing community, Tangier now faces the collapse of both home and livelihood.

title: Clyde Saxophone in: The Lick of Death
original_title: Clyde Saxophone in: The Lick of Death
overview: The Lick of Death follows Clyde Saxophone in another dastardly case. A new mysterious criminal has emerged and it’s up to Clyde Saxophone to stop them. Does he have what it takes to solve this enigma? Or will he get lost in the sauce?  Laugh, cry, vomit, and piss yourself just a little bit in this breakout classic from award-winning directors Dan Griffiths and Magnus Paulak

title: The Absence of No
overview: A sexual assault allegation at a university forces those involved and the audience to confront how quickly assumptions and appearances can distort our understanding of the truth.

title: Hammer and Nail
overview: Ondřej Blažek, confronts the raw, untold emotions behind the fight. This UFC-inspired documentary takes you deep into the mind of a fighter, where each punch carries the weight of personal sacrifice, triumph, and inner demons. With high-octane energy and cinematic intensity, Coach Ondřej revisits pivotal moments from his career, reflecting on the emotional turmoil and adrenaline that fuel him. Watch as we recreate one of his most defining fights, immersing you in the brutal reality of what it means to fight, not just against your opponent—but against yourself.

title: Across Timing
overview: Rachel, Hadrian, Stormi, and Julian are teenagers dealing with their own insecurities, desires, and fears while finding solace in conversations with a friend who watches them from behind a camera. Between spontaneous confessions and heavy silences, each of them reveals fragments of who they are and who they wish to be. But some truths are hard to face, and not all stories follow the path we imagine.

title: The Sorrows of Young Charlotte
overview: After a devastating break-up, Charlie sleeps with her friend Werther on a whim. But when he confesses his true feelings for her, an unnerving and darkly explosive argument erupts.

title: BLOODLINE: HUNT OR BE HUNTED
overview: When revenge leaves a trail of bodies behind him, fugitive Tommy Crane is hunted by detectives, bounty hunters, and the very criminal empire he tried to destroy—making him go from the hunter to the prey.

title: Through the Lens
overview: Nestled along the Great Eastern Highway in regional Western Australia stands The Big Camera — a museum housed inside a building shaped like a giant camera. What many mistake for a novelty roadside attraction is, in fact, one of the most significant private photography collections in the Southern Hemisphere.  This short documentary explores the life and legacy of The Big Camera Museum of Photography and its founder, Charles “Chic” Wadley, whose lifelong passion for capturing and preserving photographic history has created a one-of-a-kind cultural landmark.  Through personal interviews, archival imagery, cinematic visuals, and historical context, the film uncovers how this extraordinary museum came to exist, why it remains vital to regional heritage, and what it tells us about photography’s power to document human experience.

title: AWESOME MAN
overview: Austin Mann's life changes when he comes across a dark orb.

title: Zip Wire
overview: When her ground-breaking pharmaceutical discovery is stolen and partner murdered, researcher Amy must face her fear of heights to escape nefarious attackers, with the only path to salvation being a treacherous aerial runway. To outsmart the mysterious hostiles, she has to summon every ounce of courage to protect the world-changing scientific discovery — and herself — before it's too late.

title: Udders!
overview: Naked in a cornfield, a man runs for his life...

title: The Rattlin' Bog
overview: When three friends embark on a weekend getaway, their bond is put to the test as pride, fragile egos, and jealousy threaten to tear them apart.

title: Bad Karaoke
overview: When wedding band keyboardist Emily discovers an old karaoke machine in the back of a dive bar, she thinks it will lead to a fun-filled night of singing and bonding with her band mates. Unfortunately, this karaoke machine seems to have a thirst for blood. When the singing begins, so does the bloodshed. When an excellent performance allows someone to be spared by the machine, the crew think they’ve figured out how to finally beat it. Proven almost immediately wrong, it takes more horrifying deaths and a visit from a mysterious stranger to realize they may have a chance at survival after all.

title: Ithaqua
overview: During the decline of the fur trade, a mercenary struggles to unite the survivors of a famine-stricken outpost plagued by a dark force that leaves its victims with an insatiable hunger.

title: Dietary Restrictions
overview: When Hannah invites Maria over for a date, she cooks up a meal to die for.

title: You Fuckers Figure It Out: A Jason Molina Story
original_title: You Fuckers Figure It Out: A Jason Molina Story
overview: Conjure the spirit of indie-rock icon Jason Molina (1973-2013) with Ohio insiders who illuminate Truth about his coming of age on Lake Erie, escaping artless steel town indifference, and manifesting the legendary band, Songs: Ohia, as they celebrate contradictions that tether Jason’s raunchy humor, propensity to lie, refusal to interpret lyrics, and untimely death into a haunting legacy unconfined by the record vault.

title: wabi_
overview: Trapped in his nostalgia and haunted by the impermanence of things, a sad little ghost is unable to pass through the liminal space he occupies.

title: Legend of the White Dragon
overview: Forced to hide in the shadows, fugitive hero Erik Reed must clear his name to reunite with his family. Standing in his way is a mysterious villain obsessed with destroying the White Dragon for good.

title: Starsuckers
overview: A celebrity couple invite two of their biggest fans for a weekend escape, with each duo harbouring an ulterior motive.

title: Nervous
overview: A woman spirals into a seductive nightmare beyond her control as she navigates a troubled marriage and disorientating cultural terrain in the Korean countryside.

title: For Deer Life
overview: Beneath the beauty of spring lies a brutal tragedy… The birth of roe deer fawns coincides with the mowing season in Austria’s meadows, leading to a brutal struggle between nature and modern agriculture. “For Deer Life” tells the story of the dedicated drone operators, who put their heart and soul into rescuing the lives of as many fawns as possible. The film highlights the powerful combination of innovative use of thermal drones and the unwavering commitment of volunteers, to prevent this tragic loss of life. With the aim to inspire both a local and global audience to embrace technology as a conservation means, emphasising the harmonious balance between agriculture and wildlife protection.

title: The Whisper Man
overview: When his young son vanishes, a widower enlists help from his estranged father, a retired detective who put away the serial killer now linked to the case.

title: Paroxysm
overview: After a drug deal goes horribly wrong, Celia is pulled into a surreal odyssey of self-discovery. Drifting through a distorted world, she encounters temptation, desire, and paranoia as her sense of self begins to unravel and the line between reality and fantasy begin to blur around her

title: Build Me a Time Machine
overview: Young Woman longs for the innocent feeling of childhood and struggles with the thought of trying to live.

title: Desert Fiends 2
overview: A group of elite bounty hunters are on the trail to track down and kill The Desert Fiends. Meanwhile, a TikTok style influencer has come into town to have a meet up while the Desert Fiends are heading that way to eliminate that meet up.

title: Tomorrow, You Pretty Ghost
overview: Two high school theater kids, prone to playing elaborate tricks on their pals, pull off one last prank before graduation with grim consequences.

title: In Bloom
overview: A witty intern resists her totalitarian society by igniting a government coup to protect her family.

title: Willie and His Pigs
overview: Every 9 months, rural Kentucky-based regenerative farmer Willie Houston brings home a small group of piglets. He raises them, names them, cares for them, and has to say goodbye. This subtle portrait challenges assumptions of masculinity in farming and explores who bears the emotional weight of ethically raising animals.

title: Sandy
overview: As her childhood best friend prepares to depart for the US, a college student navigates her academic pursuits, strained family relationships, and a growing dread of the inevitable goodbye. ‘Sandy’ is a film about grief, memory, and how sometimes life forces you to bend into uncomfortable shapes as you go through it. Entirely self-funded and shot over two years in Davao City and Panabo City, it’s a love letter to the places and people we lose...or that lose us.

title: The Headliner
overview: The Headliner is a multi-generational musical drama that explores the evolution, exploitation, and enduring spirit of hip-hop culture. The film follows a reclusive, legendary producer from the genre's "golden era" who is forced out of retirement to collaborate with a fiercely talented but unguided modern street rapper. As they clash over the soul of their music, they must unite to fight corporate greed and protect the artistic integrity of the culture.

title: My Armor
overview: A story of April, whose inability to express her grief to her mother leads to a surreal confrontation with a Knight.

title: Novak Djokovic: The Wolf in Winter
original_title: Novak Djokovic: The Wolf in Winter
overview: He's conquered every title in tennis, including an Olympic gold. So why is Novak Djokovic still playing? The Wolf in Winter embeds with the greatest tennis player of all time as he returned to the Australian Open in 2025, capturing the obsession, the preparation, and the fire that won't go out even when there's nothing left to prove.

title: Mutiny
overview: After witnessing his billionaire boss' murder and being framed for the crime, Cole Reed boards a cargo ship on a one-man crusade to avenge his boss' death only to discover an international conspiracy.

title: Joshua
overview: A boy is trapped in his mothers basement. He has special powers.

title: Amongst Men
overview: Relatives of Charles Byrne ‘The Irish Giant’ reckon with the legacy of a man both mythologised and misunderstood and the condition that links them still.

title: Don't Let Me Down
overview: When estranged friends Michael and Elizabeth reunite, Michael finds himself struggling to leave the past behind.

title: Lesbian Ditch Day
overview: Lesbian Ditch Day starts as a rom-com-y, coming-of-age tale of two high school lesbians playing hooky, but through a fourth wall break, the film reveals itself to be just another queerbaiting tragedy.

title: The Pigeon
overview: A bereaved young woman believes her sister has been reincarnated, as a pigeon.

title: Three Black Men
overview: Can blackness escape the violence of its origins?  Three Black men set out on a transformative journey along the transatlantic slave route in reverse, exploring resistance, liberation and a new understanding of Blackness.  Their epic voyage takes them from Los Angeles to Salvador da Bahia in Brazil, and finally to Accra in Ghana. Their mission is to redefine Blackness, heal from historical trauma, and envision new paths to liberation beyond the constraints of white supremacy.

title: Skintown
overview: 1994. As Northern Ireland takes its first steps towards peace, best friends Vinny and Jonty are about to jump start their futures with the most reckless trip of their lives.

title: Best Served Cold: How a Revenge Film was Buried for Decades
original_title: Best Served Cold: How a Revenge Film was Buried for Decades
overview: A feature length cinema documentary on how THE FARMER (1977) became the most-requested cult film of the new millennium, and it's a crazy tale that involves an actor incarcerated for manslaughter, serious on-set injuries, banana-man costumes- as well as surprising links to Clint Eastwood and Martin Scorsese.  The film also broadens its scope to explore the overlooked, eclectic and often ultra-violent sub-genre THE FARMER belongs to - The Returning Veteran film. A film type that hit its stride in the 1970's with hard hitting character studies such as WELCOME HOME, SOLDIERS BOYS (1971), THE NO MERCY MAN (1973) and ROLLING THUNDER (1977).

title: Lift Me Up
overview: On the eve of her husband’s birthday, Esther struggles to come to terms with an impending event.

title: The State of Us
overview: Tearaway Frankie breaks out his best friend Taylor for one final night out. Over a riotous few hours filled with laughter, heartbreak and some home truths, the boys will face the ultimate test.

title: Abandoned
overview: Chasing a viral video to save their channel and friendship, two urban explorers break into a derelict facility scarred by sinister experiments. Trapped among its secrets, they enter a nightmare where history manifests as evil.

title: The Wrong Girls
overview: Two codependent best friends living paycheck to paycheck and bong rip to bong rip get caught in a case of mistaken identity that throws their lives into chaos.

title: RECORDING #27 - Short Film
overview: A young man records video diaries for therapy, trying to make sense of a past he can’t fully remember. But as he reviews the footage, he begins to notice something unsettling..  What starts as a quiet attempt at healing turns into a slow unraveling, as he realizes a presence has been with him far longer than he thought… and may have never left.

title: Sundown
overview: Three generations of women reunite in a remote cabin to avenge a loved one's death, only to discover their captive isn't who he seems to be, and his family is closing in, waiting for sundown.

title: Down the Arm of God
overview: A young pastor goes through a harsh winter in a small Texas town, where his mission to help the homeless is faced with resistance by his congregation, exposing deep-seated prejudice and systemic failures.

title: Bruton
overview: A tragic accident leads Bryan Bruton on a wild and unforgettable experience within the Florida prison system.

title: Enigma
overview: Natalie and Miles fall into an unusual dream in a dark room.

title: Epitaph
overview: Newlywed Anna and her husband relocate to Alaska, but their blissful life takes a dark turn when a car crash causes Anna to develop selective amnesia. The incident triggers agoraphobia and haunting flashbacks.

title: Blank Slate
overview: Claiming to remember every moment of her life, a woman spirals between past and present during an interview with her local news, revealing the hidden cost of a life she can never leave behind.

title: The Bigfoot Experiment
overview: A group of vloggers investigate an abandoned research facility, where long-buried secrets transform their search into a desperate fight for survival.

title: Homeys
overview: Set against the backdrop of Hollywood, Homeys follows four unhoused artists in Los Angeles fighting to survive while chasing their creative dreams.

title: Geronto
overview: Based on true events, GERONTO is a short LGBTQ+ coming-of-age drama about longing, connection, and self-discovery.  Set over the course of one night in the late 2000s, the story follows Younger, a man in his 20s, who meets Older, a man in his 60s, at a discreet London pub.  What begins as a tender and intimate connection soon fractures under the weight of a painful misunderstanding in a nearby hotel room, forcing both men to confront their deepest fears.  GERONTO sheds a light on the often-taboo subject of gerontophilia, and challenges societal boundaries around age and desire. Delicate yet daring, the film offers a quietly radical portrait of queer intimacy across generations.

title: irregular
overview: a collection of vignettes illustrating a typical tuesday at a dive bar in New York City.

title: Death Do Us Part
overview: Coming-of-age during the first Black Plague, a headstrong young healer defies medieval rules in an attempt to save her village, but crosses one line too many when she falls in love with Death himself.

title: Until You're Alone
overview: After becoming the lead suspect in a series of brutal slayings, a close-minded architect must team up with a free-spirited sex worker in order to clear his name and solve the crimes before they become the killer's next victims in this suspenseful, stylish, and hilarious queer love letter to Hitchcock, De Palma, and the Italian giallo.

title: Barm IV: Tracks of Blood
overview: Recently widowed barm goes on a wild train ride full of suspense and intrigue.

title: Side Effects May Include...
overview: A group of friends take a trip up to the U.P. for summer vacation. The trip takes a turn when one of them ends up dead.

title: The Assassin
overview: A man guided by his job begins to question his world.

title: The Snow Demon
overview: One year on from the disappearance of their friend, a close-knit group of friends reunite to pay their respects at the site of her disappearance. Little realizing that their friend was actually the victim of a terrifying beast known as the Ice Demon and they're next.

title: Bad News on the Doorstep
overview: Chronicles the lives of Frank and Gino, two Italian-American high-school football prodigies amidst the gritty backdrop of late 1950s New Jersey. Beyond the gridiron, they confront a myriad of trials, from the complexities of post-football existence to the allure of delving into the underworld of organized crime. As they traverse this tumultuous landscape, they glean invaluable insights and grapple with profound life lessons, shaping their destinies in unexpected ways.

title: At Night
overview: Six women in Paris traverse the anxiety of the city after dark. A filmmaker struggles to understand the film she is making. A Black single mother refuses the categories imposed on her. A former sex worker reflects on her past. A poet gives up trying for a child. Taking place over a single night, the film intertwines dream, fiction, and reality, liquefying one into the other.

title: end of beginning
overview: After waking up with no memory of his past, a man pieces together his life through archival photos and footage of the places he’s been, uncovering fragments of the identities he once lived as he confronts the relentless passage of time.

title: Otter
overview: Bubble, a young otter, lives on an island that had caught on fire. She had swim away to find a new home, she had found a new island that could concur her. But as she becomes aware of their true nature, she has to face her loneliness.

title: A Social Contract
overview: A Fourth of July dinner turns deadly when a nuclear strike is announced. A helicopter is coming for Senator Wilde—but only three others can join him. Guests fight to prove who deserves a seat before time runs out.

title: Lads Being Lads: Screen Time
overview: In this episode, the lads are challenged by James to ditch their phones and begin to connect with life like they never have before. All which leads to the group splitting and ending up facing the unfair reality of their separate paths. All in the hopes of trying something new.

title: One Night Only
overview: Two love-starved strangers crash into each other on the one night of the year when single people are allowed to have sex.

title: Pasear a un perro
overview: On another monotonous night in Javier's life, he goes out to walk his dog while thinking about the movie he just saw, not knowing that a small event is going to take him out of his depressing routine.

title: DCI 2026: Big, Loud and Live
overview: Experience the thunderous power and precision of the world’s finest marching music ensembles. “Big, Loud & Live” brings the 2026 Drum Corps International World Championship Prelims to the big screen, broadcast live from Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis. Beyond your average halftime show, the talented ensembles of Marching Music’s Major League blend world-class musicianship with breathtaking choreography and spellbinding visual formations. You’ll have the best seat in the house to witness the top 15 drum corps go head-to-head competing for their shot at the 2026 DCI World Championship title. From the earth-shaking roar of the brass to the lightning-fast precision of the percussion and color guard, see and hear every detail in stunning high definition. Whether you’re a lifelong fan or looking for a one-of-a-kind, live musical event, this is the ultimate way to experience the pinnacle of the marching arts.

title: Sweet Milk Lake
overview: After being mistaken for his twin brother by his estranged and dying dad, a soft-spoken trans man relishes the opportunity to be one of the boys, until the weight of the lie becomes heavier than his need for the truth.

title: Ice Twister
overview: A family in a mountain cabin faces a deadly ice tornado that blocks escape routes. As the storm tears apart their shelter and tensions rise, they must choose between braving the elements or staying put to face the natural disaster from hell.

title: The Incel Celebrity Kidnap Plot
overview: Details the plot to kidnap, rape and murder UK television presenter Holly Willoughby, and how it was intercepted by an undercover cop. Gavin Plumb, a 36-year-old security guard, was arrested after being detected by a cybercrime officer.

title: So Far and From Now On
original_title: So Far and From Now On
overview: Set in post-pandemic Los Angeles, Ellie tries to rebuild her life through a small online lamp shop after thirty months in jail. Yet encounters with both familiar faces and strangers draw her back to the fear she thought she had escaped.

title: The Cover Story
overview: Inside an ordinary home, a plastic cover speaks not as waste, but as a ruler. From the smallest household corner, it declares its dominance.

title: Sky to Soil
overview: A young couple with conflicting desires for intimacy attempt to celebrate their one-year anniversary.

title: The Unelected Statesman
overview: Billy Graham was a man known worldwide for his southern charm, unmistakable voice and most importantly to him, his love and devotion to Jesus Christ. Lesser known, however, is his role as a statesman of the United States. Despite never holding public office, Graham comforted the nation in some of its darkest hours, spread its causes and principles to all corners of the globe, and counseled every president from Harry Truman to George W. Bush. This is the story of the unelected statesman.

title: How To Be Happy
overview: When Max goes through a messy breakup he has to figure out how to get over his sad patch.

title: Blood Mandate
overview: A visceral action-thriller where a lone fighter is forced into a relentless pursuit by a grim ancestral decree. To satisfy a blood mandate that haunts his family's legacy, he must cut through a web of enemies and shifting alliances. As the hunt intensifies, the line between justice and revenge blurs in a raw struggle for survival.

title: Robotica
overview: Two security guards working the midnight shift in an adult toy company find themselves the target of a half-dismantled and severely malfunctioning female sex doll prototype named Robotica.

title: EPISODE 12
overview: On June 6th 2023 television show Paranormal Closure was pulled from all broadcast stations. With no statement as to why. Over a year later a video surfaced online claiming to be from the episode that never aired.

title: Sincerely, Victor
overview: A man, riddled with fear, enters the darkness of the forest. Followed by a shadowy figure, he must confront his mysterious past—or be consumed by the very thing that lured him there.

title: CHARITY!
overview: Set in 1999, 'CHARITY!' tells the story of a closeted Irish Y2K pop princess who undergoes a darkly comic assault on the senses as she wrestles with the cost of toxic fame and an evil record label who'll stop at NOTHING to make her a star.

title: City of Angels
overview: Two best friends move to Los Angeles to chase their dreams, but when a fame-hungry ritual backfires, vengeful spirits seek them out and escaping may mean sacrificing everything they came for.

title: HANDMEDOWN
overview: An experimental micro-documentary and multigenerational handing down of queer sexual wisdom and whimsy.

title: Fever Dream
overview: During the hottest days in England's history, lonely teenager Ray falls in love with a beautiful young woman. As they spend the summer together, they come to learn how love can be stronger than anything.

title: A Prince in Paradise: A Royal Wedding
original_title: A Prince in Paradise: A Royal Wedding
overview: When the fairy tale royal wedding of Olivia Perkins and Prince Alexander is derailed by an archaic law, the couple must confront an uncertain future and fight for their right to be together.

title: Frankenshark
overview: It’s the end of finals at Saint Druze College, Logan and Shreeta party their woes away until their plans are cut short but the mysterious creature only known as... FRANKENSHARK.

title: The Country They Call Life
overview: A spirit must choose between life and death with only the help of a suicidal man.

title: Jack-O 2: Blood Moon Rising
overview: sequel to the VHS rental classic Jack-O

title: The Veto
overview: For 80 years, the UN Security Council permanent member veto power has been the subject of constant debate, within the UN and without. The veto itself isn’t going away—it’s ‘veto-proof’. But when vetoes are cast in the face of genocide, war crimes, and crimes against humanity, obligations under international law and the UN Charter must be considered.  Such veto uses have led to massive loss of life, displacement of millions, and the multilateral order pushed to a breaking point.  The film, featuring leading global experts, puts aside ‘the impossibility of change’ and explores real paths to breaking the Security Council deadlock, and avoiding a third global conflict.  This is an urgent film for global audiences — it’s an issue that truly affects us all.

title: George Michael: The Trojan Souls
overview: The conversation that never finished.  In 1993, Andros Georgiou — lifelong best friend and brother to George Michael — began assembling the greatest collaborative album ever conceived. Eight of the most iconic artists in history all said yes. The album was never made. Until now, the footage has never been seen. This is Trojan Souls — the film that tells the story of what almost was.

title: Congé
overview: On a rare day off, a mother and her son make the most of their time together, until an unexpected call turns everything upside down.

title: Runners
overview: Ben is sent on a delivery job for his father, when his brother Harry unexpectedly joins him. As suspicion grows and tension rises, only one question comes to mind: what’s in the boot?

title: Human Theories
overview: Through forty interconnected vignettes, Human Theories is a comedic kaleidoscope exploring how people try, and often fail, to connect with one another in this weird world. Filmed over a year on location in New York City with a diverse ensemble cast of over 50 actors and non-actors, the film is an experimental love letter to the awkward struggle of modern city living.

title: Spare Me!
overview: A teenage bowling prodigy enters a high-stakes tournament with one goal: win the prize money and save his struggling orphanage from closing its doors. Standing in his way is a, tatted up loud mouth desperate to claim the same prize money to pay off a dangerous mob debt. As the unlikely rivals clash, the competition spirals into a showdown filled with outrageous antics. With everything on the line, it becomes more than a battle for money— it’s a fight for survival, redemption, and the only family either of them has left.

title: SUFFICIENT SIDE EFFECTS The Making Of Magenta House
original_title: SUFFICIENT SIDE EFFECTS The Making Of Magenta House
overview: SUFFICIENT SIDE EFFECTS is the definitive behind the scenes look at the making of Magenta House using extensive behind the scenes footage shot during the production of the film and interviews with most of the crew and some of the cast. It’s a unique opportunity to showcase the creation of fully independent student film which we had full control over. The good, the bad and the ugly side of film making is on full display going through all the ups and downs of such a production and hearing from those who created it both pre and post filming and right up to the film’s premiere at the Horror On Sea Film Festival.

title: The Land Demands Blood
overview: Water, woods, rock, and drifted stream. Storms overhead, fields of salt water, wicked moor. Lightning strokes and standing stones, ground hard as iron and oak, granite swallowing tin and slate. This documentary special feature examines Hammer Films use of Cornwall as a setting and location for its films, exploring the "new weird Britain" of contemporary Cornish folk horror with filmmakers, playwrights, and historians, and drawing on creative work from the region.

title: Roll the Clip!
overview: Upcoming mockumentary short film from Andrew Reid.

title: STOP THE WORLD I WANT TO GET OFF
original_title: STOP THE WORLD I WANT TO GET OFF
overview: The complex relationship between parent and child from childhood to adulthood has affected Florence's life in unthinkable ways.  She must now navigate whether to sever ties for good...or whether to give her father another chance.

title: Leavers
overview: Faced with moving on to the next chapter of their lives, four young men must confront the close-knit bonds of their friendships when two of them realise their feelings for each other.

title: Ghost Lands
overview: Follow herons, finches, and snow geese though hazy marshes and moonlit forests to trace the footsteps of renowned abolitionist Harriet Tubman and explore what it means for us to physically dwell with the ghosts of America's past. Traveling along the Harriet Tubman historical byway, Ghost Lands reflects on the the natural and unnatural landscapes Tubman would have encountered on the Delmarva Peninsula.

title: looksMAXXING
overview: When a dopamine-depleted young man joins an online forum promising a better life through physical perfection, he descends on a destructive path.

title: The Mandalorian and Grogu
overview: The evil Empire has fallen, and Imperial warlords remain scattered throughout the galaxy. As the fledgling New Republic works to protect everything the Rebellion fought for, they have enlisted the help of legendary Mandalorian bounty hunter Din Djarin and his young apprentice Grogu.

title: Plants
overview: After a ecological collapse a scientist narrates over footage of the plants humanity lost in hopes of warning any future civilization that may be lucky enough to exist in a world with plants.

title: Sugar Boy
overview: A short documentary film on the trials and triumphs of a young man's obesity journey.

title: Where Are You Alice?
overview: In a "potential" future, the True Purity Act is enacted in the U.S.A. for "societal protection," forcing all declared traitors to be removed from each state and forced into special "rehabilitation" facilities. THIS IS ONE OF THEIR STORIES…

title: Am I Funny Yet?
overview: A comedian confronts his own thoughts of suicide on stage, turning his personal crisis into an uncomfortable comedy.

title: They Wait in Shadows
overview: Two sisters returning to their family home after their mother's death, only to confront the monsters they accidentally conjured with a Ouija board.

title: Crank and Drag and All That Slag
original_title: Crank and Drag and All That Slag
overview: Crank and Drag and All That Slag follows two punk-rock monsters working the graveyard shift at a monsters-only sandwich shop called Slabway, where the moto is Eat flesh! When Crank's boyfriend Sterling comes in for a pre-date visit, he has an unexpected confrontation with Susan, the heinous Gorgon manager of Slabway, and chaos ensues. Relationships are tested and sandwiches are made in this scare-raising workplace comedy!

title: Bodyhackers
overview: An environmental activist Denver Blake has decided to expose a cosmetics corporation that he believes is exploiting the insecurities caused by societal beauty standards. However, when he falls in love with Renée, a former ballerina obsessed with constantly improving her beauty, he becomes drawn into a mesmerizing underworld of plastic surgery.

title: 742 Evergreen
overview: Two on call police officers respond to a call, where they suspect everything is not what it seems
